page.overview:
Who is Zammorto family?

The Zammortos are a family of dwarven origin who own and run the Zammorto Bank.

The Zammorto family founded their bank in Novigrad, where they faced fierce competition from other dwarven banks. Despite this, they managed to solidify their family's position, with the bank president, Gabron Zammorto, traditionally holding the head position in the Guild of Bankers.
